_label: DIRECT LINK CHECK (second pass, 7 approved hosts) — research record, not an approval
method: Second pass over the 9 records with opened=false in direct-check-2026-11.json. Each url from ../resources.candidate.json (matched by code) was requested once with curl (GET, following redirects of that url only, 30 s timeout) through the environment's HTTPS proxy; only the 7 approved hosts (react.dev, google.github.io, github.com, www.gov.uk, cucumber.io, www.atlassian.com, learn.microsoft.com) were contacted. Status code and effective URL from curl; page_title from the served <title>; language_served from the <html lang> attribute; free_access from whether the served HTML contained the article text with no sign-in/paywall prompt; duration only where the page text states one. No scripts were executed, nothing else was downloaded, nothing was crawled. For each host, the licence/terms page linked from the resource page footer was opened once (only if it was on an approved host) and short phrases were quoted. docs.github.com was attempted once and refused by the proxy ('CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'), so per instructions it was skipped and is not in hosts; its licence remains 'unclear' as in the first pass. hosts_without_terms counts hosts where no licence/terms page could be opened or the page opened was not a terms page.
